name: zzz-stack-assert-roster
title: VPA stack assert (roster)
author: deadrat22
description: Test-only assert mod for the vanilla-plus-arsenal stack-load test; logs E2E_CHECK markers that tests/proto/roster/expected-B.txt greps for. The optional dependency on vanilla-plus-arsenal forces this mod to load after it in the data stages (dependency edges beat alphabetical order), so the buff assertions observe the final patched values. Not for distribution.
